stage: prepublication checks; deployment receipt is recorded separately

semantics: all direct dependency answer combinations across every real argument path
required answers and optional blank notes
separate omitted reasons and private exports
security: verified Google identity and active assignment
stale and simultaneous edits cannot silently overwrite

browser.required_answer: Blank unblocked page rejected; Yes with blank optional notes continued
browser.back_and_network: Back changed progress; network links focused the selected claim or argument without resampling order
browser.summary: UNN Both: all 10 headings and judgments, accepted highlighting and complete expandable text. UNC Neither: all 29 headings, both evidence links and separate omitted-reason fields; blank optional opposing note accepted
browser.comparison: Pending accepted; changing one direct answer retained the earlier comparison but unchecked it and requested reassessment; incomplete edited page remained flagged
browser.exports: Production QA JSON and CSV previews contained saved answers/order/progress; revision export returned revisions 1 through 4. Private copies kept outside GitHub
browser.production_return: Google-authenticated QA session revision 4 survived closing and a new tab, with identical 110-item order, answer and cursor
browser.two_contexts: Independent localhost and 127.0.0.1 browser storage contexts read the same dummy reviewer session. Device B saved revision 11 while A retained an unsent draft; A displayed both versions. Explicitly choosing A created revision 12; B received it
browser.interrupted_save: Local QA storage-boundary simulation displayed Not saved, retained the draft, and prevented false confirmation. Closing the tab during the failure and reopening restored the exact note and saved it as revision 15
browser.access: An unassigned second dummy account displayed Reviewer access required and no coding record; its later assigned fixture had separate records

layouts.long_context: capped with internal scrolling; reference person reachable
layouts.short_context: content height plus normal padding, below cap
layouts.navigation: center equals reader center at tested widths

browser.source_access: Existing HTTPS source URLs retained and rendered as external links; shared links route to claim pages; source namespaces and citation preservation checked against frozen content

preservation.production_qa: separate --qa session; no prefilled research record
preservation.billing: Spark; no paid services or invitations

limits: Browser contexts and viewport emulation, not a physical second device
Connection failure was simulated at the save boundary, not a physical network outage
Source text matching is not a new comprehensive evidence review
ESL clarity and coder effort need a human pilot; software tests establish no reliability improvement
